subject: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <s.chen@finhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@finhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Hi Sarah / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call so we have shared expectations and clear next steps. If I missed anything, please flag.

Key pain points you called out:
- Handling PHI across several inference pipelines (clinical notes parsing + patient-facing summarization) — primary driver is strict data residency and auditability.
- Current latency variability and cost spikes when load increases; want predictable latency for SLAs.
- Need for no-data-egress to public internet and strict egress filtering on connectors.

Current stack / constraints:
- Primary cloud: AWS (us-east-1), workloads run in VPCs with strict egress rules.
- Using AWS KMS for key management today; they require customer-managed keys and key policy control.
- On-prem presence in a single data center for legacy batch processing; interested in air-gapped options for future regulatory projects.
- Compliance: must support BAA (HIPAA) and provide SOC2 reports + audit logs.

Success criteria for an initial pilot (what you asked for):
1) Private/VPC deployment that keeps inference traffic inside FinHealth networking (no public egress).
2) Customer-managed KMS integration + optional HSM support.
3) Demonstrated audit logs for requests + admin actions, retention configurable to 1+ years.
4) <100ms median token latency for the primary endpoint at expected pilot throughput.
5) Signed BAA and security review complete.

Open questions we took away
- Do you require an air-gapped (fully offline) appliance for the pilot, or is a private VPC with no public egress sufficient for the first phase?
- Can you share the expected peak concurrency / tokens-per-minute for the pilot? (We need this to size Dedicated capacity).

Next steps
- Aditya (cc'ed) will lead a technical deep-dive to validate architecture and run through our VPC networking checklist. Please pick a 60-min slot here: https://cal.com/redwood/aditya/60
- I'll share a short questionnaire and our standard BAA draft (attached) + an architecture sketch.
- After the deep-dive we'll propose a pilot SOW and capacity estimate.

Attachments: finhealth-vpc-requirements.xlsx (high-level constraints sheet)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Sarah Chen <s.chen@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@finhealth.com>, FinHealth InfoSec <infosec@finhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap; this matches our notes. A few clarifications from InfoSec / infra side:

- KMS: we use AWS KMS CMKs with a custom key policy. Any deployment will need to allow us to bring our own key and manage rotation. Do you integrate with customer-managed KMS keys in the VPC path?
- BAA: we do need a signed BAA before the pilot. Can you share your standard language?
- Air-gap: for the initial pilot, a private VPC w/ strict no-egress policy is acceptable. For PHI-bound projects later this year, we'll likely require an air-gapped on-prem appliance — do you have an air-gap option and what is the estimated lead time for that?
- Sizing: for pilot we expect ~30 concurrent users; peak forecast ~3k tokens/sec across all model endpoints.

Also, pricing: can you give a ballpark for a 3-month pilot (Dedicated small pool) so I can budget for a procurement request?

If Aditya can do a technical deep-dive tomorrow or Friday morning we'd prefer that.

Thanks,
Sarah
Director, AI Platforms | FinHealth
s.chen@finhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Aditya / Michael —

Fwd'ing FinHealth's replies and asks. Highlights for SE / infra:
- They require BYOK (AWS KMS CMK) + optional HSM; must be able to route key usage through their KMS.
- Pilot can be VPC-only (no public egress) but later may need an on-prem, air-gapped appliance.
- Expected pilot load: ~30 concurrent, peak ~3k tokens/sec — to get sizing right we'll need your throughput/cost estimates and an initial arch diagram.
- Procurement will want a 3-month pilot price range from us.

Please prepare:
1) A VPC networking checklist + recommended security controls for private deployment.
2) High-level arch diagram showing KMS integration and data flow for the VPC-only deployment. (redwood-arch-diagram.png)
3) Pilot capacity/cost estimate (Dedicated small pool) and delta to air-gapped option.
4) Draft answers to their compliance questions (BAA process + SOC2 evidence items).

Target: have slides + draft SOW by EOD Wednesday so I can share with procurement.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <s.chen@finhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth — Private/VPC discovery recap & next steps

Sarah —

Appreciate the quick responses and the sizing info — very helpful. Short answers to your questions:

- KMS/BYOK: Yes, we support customer-managed keys for our Private deployment. For VPC deployments we can integrate with your AWS KMS CMKs; for on-prem/air-gapped we support HSM-backed keys with local key material (we'll need to run through key provisioning during the tech deep-dive).
- BAA: attaching our standard BAA draft for review (redwood-baa-draft.pdf). Legal is available to iterate.
- Air-gap lead time: we have an on-prem appliance option; typical lead time for a fully air-gapped deployed PoC is 8–12 weeks (engineering/ops dependent). We'll scope a trimmed pilot that can run in a VPC initially to accelerate time-to-value.
- Pricing: rough pilot estimate for a 3-month Dedicated small pool + support is ~$45k–$60k; we'll provide a formal quote after the deep-dive and sizing.

Next steps:
- Aditya: can you take the technical deep-dive tomorrow 10:00–11:00 AM EST? Sarah / Rajiv let me know if that works. (Booking link: https://cal.com/redwood/aditya/60)
- I'll upload the VPC checklist + diagram to the shared drive and follow up with a draft SOW.

Looking forward to the deep-dive — we'll make sure the pilot is scoped to reduce risk and speed up procurement.

Best,
Marissa Cole
